rows.scope: Pixel RasterizerOrderedByteAddressBuffer, RasterizerOrderedTexture2D<uint>, and RasterizerOrderedStructuredBuffer<uint> with one pixel and three overlapping primitives. The direct MSL ABI attaches raster_order_group(0) to each marked UAV resource. A two-render-target IndependentBlendEnable variant using the ROV pixel shader must reject PSO creation before replay.

Typed ROV buffer fixture and R32_UINT typed UAV view execute the exact three-overlap ordered load/increment/store matrix under the selected isolated runtime. The broader resource/stage/state matrix remains outside this bounded provider.

Three clipped/partially covered triangles over an 8x8 R8G8B8A8 target, with CPU conservative triangle-box reference comparison and exact red/zero readback. Degenerate/top-left/line/MSAA/VRS/array interactions remain open.
A four-pixel, four-sample programmable pattern changes raster coverage and resolves to an exact black/red pixel matrix. Broader sample-count/pattern and state interactions remain open.

Two-view pipeline-stream instancing replays validated viewport/render-target array locations and SetViewInstanceMask, with exact per-slice SV_ViewID output. Arbitrary view count/layouts remain outside this bounded provider; barycentric interpolation has its own default-perspective row.
Default perspective SV_Barycentrics at the center of a one-pixel full-screen triangle. Noperspective, centroid, sample, and additional barycentric inputs remain fail-closed/outside scope.
The typed provider executes the native16 arithmetic and math cases through Metal half operations. The Options4 report promotes only native16; 64-KB MSAA texture alignment remains fail-closed.

The compute semantic probe passes all declared binary64 arithmetic, IEEE-754 edge, comparison, conversion, unary, predicate, and FMA cases. This is emulation, not native Metal double ALU, and the public report is tied to this provider.

Two R8G8B8A8 render targets with IndependentBlendEnable and a D32 depth attachment with depth writes enabled. Target 0 applies XOR and target 1 applies AND to distinct initialized values; replay binds one Metal global logic operation at a time while masking the other attachments, then performs one state-only depth replay. A separate UAV-writing pixel PSO is rejected before replay because repeated draws would duplicate those effects.

The GraphicsCommandList9 topology lane lowers unindexed and upload/GPU-readable indexed triangle fans, and dynamic 0xffffffff strip-cut segments, to explicit triangle-list indices. Non-readable or malformed index ranges remain fail-closed.
A depth-enabled one-pixel triangle proves the command-recorded dynamic bias changes an equal-depth LESS test to a passing fragment. Non-finite command values are rejected.

One-pixel D24_UNORM_S8_UINT stencil test with front and back triangles. Front/ref 5 and back/ref 7 are applied through the Agility 1.619.5 GraphicsCommandList8 method; the exact yellow additive readback proves both references are independently consumed. Broader stencil masks, operations, and depth interactions remain open.

rows.remaining: Broader unsupported image shapes and rates remain fail-closed.
General geometry/tessellation breadth, conservative-raster edge/degenerate/line/MSAA/VRS interactions, barycentric interpolation variants, and complete MSAA/raster-state matrices remain open.
